summary: Runs Python callbacks on every cook to procedurally create, delete, and edit SOP points, primitives, vertices, and attributes.

key_params.name: setuppars
key_params.note: Run setupParameters() to create custom parameters

common_gotchas: cook() can run often, so generated geometry should be deterministic and bounded.
Procedural dependencies can be broad because the script can access operators, parameters, and nodes from anywhere.
setuppars only runs setupParameters(); custom pulse parameters trigger onPulse().
Callback names are case-sensitive Python method names.
key_concepts: Script SOP runs Python each time the SOP cooks.
It can create, delete, and modify points, primitives, vertices, and built-in or custom attributes such as Cd, uv, and N.
The default docked callbacks DAT contains cook(), onPulse(), and setupParameters().
Because dependencies can be discovered dynamically, TouchDesigner rebuilds the Script OP dependency list after it runs.
